About the Role

Apollo is hiring a Business Recruiter to own full-cycle recruiting across our G&A, Sales and Marketing organizations. This is a high-ownership role on a lean, high-performing team. You will manage a portfolio of mid and senior-level requisitions, build and execute sourcing strategies, and serve as a genuine business partner to your hiring managers. This role requires someone who operates with low oversight, self-diagnoses problems before they escalate, and brings a talent advisor posture to every stakeholder conversation. The best person for this role brings their own operating system and makes the team around them sharper.

What You Will Do

• Own full-cycle recruiting for mid and senior-level roles across G&A, Sales and Marketing, with consistent delivery across multiple verticals simultaneously

• Build and execute sourcing strategies that generate qualified, diverse pipelines, and adapt those strategies based on funnel performance, not just instinct

• Conduct structured screens and interviews, design interview plans, and lead calibrated debriefs that result in clear, defensible hiring decisions

• Manage 20+ phone screens per week and drive 360+ outbound contacts per quarter

• Hold the bar on candidate quality, give direct and honest feedback, and avoid passing weak profiles to sidestep an uncomfortable conversation

• Maintain accurate, real-time pipeline data in Greenhouse and self-report on progress to leadership without being asked

• Track funnel metrics, identify root causes of slowdowns, and bring data-informed recommendations to stakeholder conversations

• Partner with hiring managers and business leaders as a talent advisor: shape role scoping, set expectations on candidate profiles, and influence as a subject matter expert.

• Work cross-functionally with Finance, HR, and Compensation to navigate offer approvals and headcount processes with operational integrity

• Build or improve multiple workflows, processes, or tools that create efficiency beyond your own req load

What We Are Looking For

• 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience with a focus on Sales, Revenue, or Marketing roles in SaaS

• Demonstrated delivery in high-growth environments where you managed complexity and ambiguity

• Comfort and credibility working with stakeholders at all levels, including the ability to challenge and influence, not just execute

• Strong data fluency: you monitor your own funnel health, diagnose issues before they surface in a check-in, and use data to drive stakeholder conversations

• Proven AI and process efficiency capability: you have built repeatable workflows or automation that measurably improved your output, and you can speak to what you built, why it works, and what changed

• Familiarity with Revenue teams, high-performing marketing orgs, and product-led growth models

• Hands-on experience with Greenhouse and Gem, with clean data hygiene as a non-negotiable operating habit

• Clear, direct communicator who can influence without authority across functions

• High agency: you identify problems, generate solutions, and drive progress without waiting for direction

c9a075bc0336da25.description: ## **About Juniper Square** Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us! *Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in* [*digital-first*](https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/) *operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.* ## **About your role** Juniper Square is growing rapidly, and our data needs are growing even faster, so we’re growing our Data Engineering Team. As a Senior Data Engineer, your role will be pivotal to evolving our existing data and reporting experiences. You’ll build out pipelines to gather data from multiple sources and make it available for analysis. You will shape both internal and external analytics products to help guide business-critical decisions, enhance their workflows, and improve decision-making. ## **What you'll do** - Design and implement sophisticated data models in SQL. - Work closely with the other Software Engineers to ensure sound, scalable implementation. - Act as a technical expert on our team regarding all things data, especially as the data team grows and evolves. - Introduce new technologies to evolve and enhance our data pipeline capabilities. - Document data models, architectural decisions and data dictionaries to enable collaboration, maintainability and usability of our analytics platforms and code. - Assist with governance, guidance, code reviews, and access controls so that we maintain consistency, quality, and business confidentiality as we scale analytics access across the company and to customers. - Externally: learn our application data schema, and develop a fluency in how to transform it to enhance customers’ decision-making with data. - Internally: guide product and development teams, advising on instrumentation and laying development foundations for product usage reporting. - Fullfill projects with minimal guidance but with an appropriate sense of when and how to collaborate with others. - Build scalable, highly performant infrastructure for delivering clear business insights from a variety of raw data sources. ## **Qualifications** - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent work experience - 7-11 years of experience building ETL (Extraction Transform Load) or ELT (Extraction Load Transform) pipelines from scratch - Strong command of relational databases (Postgresql preferred), data modeling and database design - Strong command of Python and experience building production web applications using Python - Experience with cloud-based services (AWS RDS preferred) - Experience developing on (or administering) BI/data visualization platforms (ex. Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, Mode, Data Studio, Domo, QlikView etc.). - Basic understanding of data warehouses such as Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery, Snowflake etc. - Demonstrated history of translating data into clear and actionable narratives and communicating opportunities and challenges relevant to stakeholders. - You must be flexible and adaptable – you will be operating in a fast-paced startup environment. - Familiarity with data catalog or data governance platforms – open source (e.g. OpenMetadata) or commercial. - Experience building backend services using Python/FastAPI and designing and implementing scalable RESTful and GraphQL APIs - Mandatory Experience authoring modern web applications using ReactJS and TypeScript, and designing reusable UI components and scalable frontend architecture. - Familiarity with patterns such as tool-calling agents, planning/execution loops, and RAG - Demonstrated ability to use modern AI tools to improve velocity and code quality *At Juniper Square, we believe building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture makes us a better company. If you think this job sounds like a fit, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the qualifications*

Headquarters: United States
 
URL: https://engine.com/

About the Role

We're looking for a VP, Finance to lead Finance at Engine and serve as a strategic partner to our CEO and executive leadership team. 

You'll own the financial strategy and operating cadence of the company, from planning and forecasting to capital allocation, business performance, financial reporting, and long-range strategy. You'll help leadership understand what is driving the business, where we should invest, and what we need to do next. You'll also be the architect of Engine's financial story, shaping how the company is understood by its Board, investors, and partners.

You'll build the Finance organization and infrastructure to support Engine through its next phase of growth. That means creating clarity where there is ambiguity, building scalable processes before they become bottlenecks, and using data, systems, and AI to make Finance increasingly leveraged.

Success in this role will be measured by business impact and the results of the Finance organization.

What You'll Do

Strategic Financial Leadership

• Serve as the CEO's financial thought partner on growth strategy, investment priorities, resource allocation, and profitability. Drive capital allocation decisions across the executive team — where Engine invests people, capital, and resources, and where we make tradeoffs. Bring financial rigor to pricing, monetization, new products, markets, and partnerships.

Capital Strategy & Transactions

• Own fundraising, debt and liquidity strategy, M&A, and other strategic transactions. Build investor relationships, lead the Board story on performance, and prepare Engine for future capital events — including the reporting, controls, and governance a public-ready company requires (SOX readiness, audit committee partnership, external guidance frameworks).

Financial Planning & Business Insight

• Own the financial plan — quarterly forecasting, long-range modeling, scenario analysis, and the operating cadence across Engine. Develop a deep understanding of revenue, margins, customer economics, pricing, payment economics, and cash flow. Build the metrics and frameworks that make the business legible to leadership.

Narrative & Communication

• Tell Engine's financial story to the Board, investors, lenders, and partners — turning complex numbers into a narrative leadership can act on and external audiences believe. Lead financial reporting and help the CEO communicate performance, outlook, risks, opportunities, and key decisions with clarity.

Build Finance for Scale

• Build and lead a high-performance Finance team — attracting exceptional talent, modernizing through AI and automation, and establishing systems, processes, data infrastructure, and controls that scale without creating bureaucracy. Partner with Accounting, Treasury, Legal, and external advisors to ensure Engine has the financial foundation required to scale responsibly.

What You'll Bring

Experience and Background

• 12+ years of experience across investment banking, private equity, growth equity, corporate finance, FP&A, strategic finance, or a related field, with significant experience in high-growth technology.

• Investment banking or private equity background, with hands-on experience in valuation, transaction execution, and capital markets. Strongly preferred.

• Experience leading Finance, or a major component of Finance, at a high-growth tech, SaaS, marketplace, fintech, or similarly complex company.

Financial Expertise

• Exceptional financial modeling skills and a strong understanding of three-statement modeling, unit economics, cash flow, and capital allocation.

• A track record of building financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and analytical infrastructure in environments that are scaling quickly.

• Experience evaluating pricing, monetization, new products, investments, headcount, and other strategic decisions.

Communication and Partnership

• A track record of communicating complex financial stories to investors, boards, and executive teams in ways that drive decisions and build confidence.

• Experience partnering directly with a CEO, executive team, and Board.

Leadership and Team Building

• Experience building and developing high-performing Finance teams. Comfort operating without a fully defined playbook and  building structure where it doesn’t exist.

Judgment and Execution

• Strong commercial instincts. You understand that Finance exists to help the business make better decisions, not simply to explain what happened last quarter.

• The ability to operate at both the strategic and tactical level and an usually high bar for execution and bias towards action

• Strong conviction and judgment. You bring a point of view vs just presenting options.

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range

$300,000 - $375,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

• Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.

• Benefits: Check out our full list at engine.com/culture 

• Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/engine-vp-finance

About the Role:

We are seeking an accomplished and highly driven Senior Technical Program Manager to lead strategic Sales & Marketing programs in Rubrik IT. You will own planning and delivery of high-impact cross-functional programs that span Go-To-Market, Marketing automation, Web marketing, Sales Compensation, and Partner enablement. You will provide visible leadership, accountability, and governance across initiatives, from intake and prioritization through execution, go-live, and post-implementation optimization.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with a proven track record delivering complex technology programs, a deep understanding of Sales & Marketing processes, and exceptional collaboration skills to partner effectively with business stakeholders and technical teams.

What You’ll Do:

  • Program Strategy & Governance

    • Define, champion, and execute the Sales & Marketing IT initiatives, aligned to company-wide business objectives, GTM strategy, and annual planning priorities.
    • Lead one or more concurrent, complex programs involving one or more of these domains - CRM, CPQ, Marketing Automation, Web Marketing, Sales Performance Management, and Sales Commissions.
    • Champion responsible use of LLMs (e.g., Claude) in Sales & Marketing workflows, setting guardrails for security, compliance, and data privacy in collaboration with InfoSec and Legal.
    • Partner with IT and business teams to translate business goals (Pipeline growth, Conversion, retention, Marketing efficiency, Partner performance) into clear program charters, success metrics, and implementation plans.
    • Establish program governance (cadence, forums, decision-making, risk and issue management) for Sales & Marketing IT initiatives.
    • Implement and continuously improve a unified Program Management framework and tooling (e.g., JIRA, Confluence) for Sales & Marketing IT.
    • Leverage AI into the overall SDLC in alignment with Rubrik’s Native AI expectations.

  • Program Delivery & Execution

    • Create and own the program plan including cross-functional key deliverables. Negotiate and get cross functional alignment. Partner with Business and IT teams to align and commit on the program Scope, Schedule and Resources.
    • Own the full lifecycle: demand intake, scoping, solution approach, detailed planning, execution, testing / UAT, deployment, stabilization, and post-go-live optimization.
    • Build and manage integrated plans that cover business milestones, technical delivery, dependencies, data and reporting, and change management.
    • Track scope, timeline, budget, and quality, proactively identify risks and interdependencies and drive mitigations and trade-off decisions with stakeholders.

  • Sales & Marketing Domain Leadership

    • Partner with Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Product Operations, Channel/Partner teams, and Commissions to prioritize and deliver programs across:
      • CRM (i.e. CPQ Cloud, Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing integrations)
      • Marketing automation and web marketing (i.e. Marketo, Adobe Experience Manager, campaign and lead lifecycle)
      • Sales performance management and commissions (i.e. Xactly Incent)
      • Partner portals and enablement tools
    • Ensure solutions are designed with scalability, data quality, compliance, and user experience in mind.

  • Stakeholders, Vendors & Continuous Improvement

    • Act as the central point of contact across business stakeholders and IT delivery teams.
    • Facilitate alignment between business stakeholders, product managers, architects, developers, QA, data engineers, and admins for each program.
    • Communicate program status, risks, decisions, and outcomes clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
    • Drive structured stakeholder engagement, including steering committees, executive readouts, business reviews, and change-management updates.
    • Partner with Procurement, Finance, and Legal to manage vendor relationships, SaaS licensing, and contracts across Sales & Marketing tools.
    • Track budgets and spend across programs, provide regular financial updates, including forecasts, variances, and cost-saving opportunities.
    • Ensure vendors and system integrators deliver to contracted scope, quality, and timelines.
    • Champion best practices in program management, GTM process design, and application lifecycle management for Sales & Marketing IT.
    • Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce manual work, improve data quality, and enhance user experience.
    • Mentor project managers, business analysts, and scrum masters, foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Experience You’ll Need:

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in IT program / project management, technology consulting, or enterprise applications, with at least 8 years leading Sales & Marketing or GTM-focused programs.
  • Understanding of Sales & Marketing processes across lead lifecycle, opportunity management, forecasting, campaign management, sales performance management, commissions, and partner programs.
  • Hands-on experience delivering complex programs on CRM and marketing platforms (e.g., Salesforce Sales Cloud / Service Cloud, Marketo, Adobe Experience Manager, or equivalent).
  • Hands-on proficiency with generative AI platforms (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) to automate project documentation, accelerate decision-making, and streamline cross-functional workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage LLMs and prompt engineering to synthesize complex program data, conduct rapid risk analysis, and produce executive-level reporting.
  • Track record of integrating frontier AI tools into daily program management practices to enhance operational velocity, optimize stakeholder communication, and drive efficient problem-solving.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional, global teams and manage stakeholders at multiple levels, including senior business leaders.
  • Proven track record establishing program governance, managing budgets, and driving projects to successful completion in fast-paced environments.
  • Proficiency with Agile and hybrid delivery models, and with project / program management tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to define business cases, quantify ROI, and make data-driven decisions.

Nice To Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. A Masters degree is a plus.
  • Experience in high-growth technology companies working closely with global Sales, Marketing, and GTM Operations teams.
  • Formal program / project management certifications (e.g., PMP, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2, SAFe, or equivalent).

c9b9fdd514a4092b.description: We are looking for an AI Developer with 2–4 years of software/AI development experience to build and evolve customer-facing AI capabilities. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building production AI systems that understand user conversations, maintain relevant context, retrieve information, interact with application services and tools, and generate useful, safe, and reliable responses. We are looking for someone who understands that production AI engineering goes beyond prompt writing. You should be comfortable working across LLMs, Python, APIs, RAG, memory, structured outputs, evaluation, observability, and production debugging. **Key Responsibilities** - Develop conversational and Generative AI applications using modern LLMs. - Build and maintain AI backend services using Python and FastAPI or similar frameworks. - Implement prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, streaming, and tool/function calling. - Build RAG pipelines using embeddings, vector search, metadata filtering, reranking, and contextual retrieval. - Design short-term and long-term conversational memory and personalization mechanisms. - Integrate AI capabilities with internal APIs, databases, and business systems. - Develop AI workflows and agentic capabilities where appropriate. - Implement model routing, retry, timeout, fallback, and error-handling strategies. - Build safeguards for prompt injection, inappropriate tool usage, PII handling, and unreliable model responses. - Develop automated evaluations and regression tests for AI behaviour. - Monitor AI systems for response quality, latency, errors, token consumption, and cost. - Debug and continuously improve AI behaviour based on production observations. **Required Skills** - 2–4 years of software/AI engineering experience - Strong Python programming skills - Experience with FastAPI or similar backend frameworks - Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs - Good understanding of prompt and context engineering - Experience with structured LLM outputs and/or function calling - Understanding of RAG architecture - Understanding of embeddings and vector search - Experience integrating REST APIs and third-party services - Understanding of asynchronous programming - Experience with Git and standard software development practices - Ability to write maintainable and testable production code - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills **** Expected AI Knowledge**** Candidates should have a practical understanding of: - LLMs and transformer fundamentals - Tokens and context windows - Embeddings and semantic similarity - RAG - Prompt and context engineering - Tool/function calling - Structured generation - Hallucination and grounding - Prompt injection - Model latency, quality, and cost trade-offs - Evaluation of non-deterministic AI systems **Good to Have** Experience with some of the following would be valuable: - OpenRouter - OpenAI / Anthropic / Google Gemini APIs - Mem0 - LangGraph - LangChain - Langfuse or LangSmith - Redis - MongoDB / PostgreSQL - Vector databases - Docker - Kubernetes - AWS / Azure / GCP - Background workers and queues - WebSockets and streaming responses Experience building production customer-facing conversational AI applications is particularly valuable. **AI Safety & Reliability** The developer will contribute to building AI systems with appropriate safeguards, including: - Input and output validation - Prompt-injection protection - Tool permission boundaries - PII-aware data handling - Domain-specific guardrails - Safe fallback mechanisms - Human escalation where appropriate - Monitoring and auditability **What We Are Looking For** We are looking for an AI application engineer rather than primarily an ML researcher. The role is focused on combining foundation models with software, APIs, application data, retrieval, memory, workflows, tools, evaluation, and guardrails to create reliable production AI capabilities. A strong candidate should be able to take a requirement such as: "The AI should understand the customer's request, identify the appropriate context, retrieve relevant information, call application services when required, and generate an accurate and safe response." …and convert it into a well-designed, testable, production-ready implementation. We value engineers who enjoy building, experimenting, measuring, debugging, and continuously improving real-world AI systems.

c9cee3af455bef26.description: Company Description Battery Dost is an emerging leader in battery swapping solutions for electric three-wheelers in India, helping reshape the countrys EV ecosystem. The company operates a convenient and efficient battery swapping network that supports multiple battery types and models, reducing vehicle downtime for users. By extending driving range and simplifying access to charging alternatives, Battery Dost enables greater reliability for e-rickshaws, cargo vehicles, and other three-wheeled EVs. Its solutions promote widespread EV adoption, reduce carbon emissions, and contribute to more sustainable urban transportation. Joining Battery Dost offers the opportunity to work on impactful, future-focused technologies in the clean mobility space. Role Description The Finance Analyst Banks, NBFCs, and Leasing at Battery Dost is a full-time, on-site role based in Gurugram. This role is responsible for analyzing and managing financial relationships with banks, non-banking financial companies (NBFCs), and leasing partners to support Battery Dosts expansion and operations. Daily tasks include conducting financial analysis, preparing reports and dashboards, monitoring credit facilities, assessing funding requirements, and supporting negotiations on loan, leasing, and financing terms. The Finance Analyst will collaborate with internal stakeholders to evaluate investment proposals, manage cash flows related to financing arrangements, and ensure compliance with relevant financial regulations and policies. The role also involves tracking industry trends in EV financing, recommending improvements to financial structures, and contributing to the companys long-term financial planning. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong financial analysis and modeling skills, including proficiency in interpreting financial statements and evaluating credit and lending structures. Candidates should possess capabilities in banking and NBFC relationship management, including experience with loan documentation, leasing arrangements, and negotiations with financial institutions. Candidates should possess knowledge of corporate finance and treasury operations, including cash flow management, funding strategy, and risk assessment. Candidates should possess analytical and research skills, with the ability to gather market data, track industry trends, and present clear, data-driven insights. Candidates should possess strong communication and documentation skills, including report writing, presentation development, and clear stakeholder communication. Relevant qualifications such as a bachelors degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CFA, CA, MBA in Finance) are an advantage. Experience in financial services, EV/automotive, infrastructure, or leasing sectors, particularly in dealing with banks and NBFCs, is highly beneficial. Ability to work on-site in Gurugram, collaborate cross-functionally, use financial software and spreadsheets effectively, and maintain high ethical standards and attention to detail. .
